visual_logic.surface_detail: Leathery skin with 'Sandy Brown' mottling; specialized tooth arrangement is mapped cleanly along the lateral jawline across its horizontal side profile.
visual_logic.anatomy_focus: Strict side-profile view configured to display the animal's maximum horizontal length for accurate top-by-bottom size comparisons. Hero focus remains heavily on the unique 'macro-predatory' teeth—displaying the varying sizes of crushing and piercing teeth oriented perfectly parallel to the frame edge.
visual_logic.environment: Warm, shallow Cretaceous seas with high-key lighting, maintaining clear water conditions with background elements set deep to prevent obstruction.
visual_logic.pose: The ichthyosaur is oriented entirely in a strict lateral profile view, swimming horizontally from left to right parallel to the frame boundaries. The original active clamping pose is converted into a level, straight cruising path, extending its specialized fanged snout, torpedo-shaped torso, dorsal fin, and deep tail fluke end-to-end to trace flawlessly alongside the central UI measuring tape system. The ammonite is held straight or relocated to a background layer to ensure the lower silhouette line stays perfectly crisp and measurable.
